title: [Arista] test_route_flap failed due to index out of range
author: Blueve
body:

**Description**

<!--
Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->

The test failed due to index out of range

```
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9233214Z duthost = <MultiAsicSonicHost bjw-can-720dt-1>
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9244967Z tbinfo = {'auto_recover': 'True', 'comment': 'Beijing lab', 'conf-name': 'bjw-vms6-t0-720dt-1', 'duts': ['bjw-can-720dt-1'], ...}
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9255861Z ptfhost = <tests.common.devices.ptf.PTFHost object at 0x7f8ea0af3710>
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9266429Z ptfadapter = <tests.common.plugins.ptfadapter.ptfadapter.PtfTestAdapter testMethod=runTest>
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9277590Z get_function_conpleteness_level = 'confident', announce_default_routes = None
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9281797Z 
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9289783Z     def test_route_flap(duthost, tbinfo, ptfhost, ptfadapter,
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9299013Z                         get_function_conpleteness_level, announce_default_routes):
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9302925Z         ptf_ip = tbinfo['ptf_ip']
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9306813Z         common_config = tbinfo['topo']['properties']['configuration_properties'].get('common', {})
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9310209Z         nexthop = common_config.get('nhipv4', NHIPV4)
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9313377Z         dut_mac = duthost.facts['router_mac']
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9316122Z     
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9318749Z         #get dst_prefix_list and aspath
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9321776Z         routes = namedtuple('routes', ['route', 'aspath'])
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9324835Z         iproute_info = get_ip_route_info(duthost)
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9327775Z         dst_prefix_list = []
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9330814Z         for route_prefix in iproute_info:
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9333983Z             if "/25" in route_prefix:
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9338002Z                 # Use only multipath routes, othervise there will be announced new routes to T0 neigbours on t1 topo
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9342621Z                 multipath = iproute_info[route_prefix][0].get('multipath', False)
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9346289Z                 if multipath:
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9349381Z                     out = iproute_info[route_prefix][0].get('path').split(' ')
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9352473Z                     aspath = out[1:]
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9355554Z                     entry = routes(route_prefix, ' '.join(aspath))
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9358615Z                     dst_prefix_list.append(entry)
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9361473Z     
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9364191Z >       route_to_ping = dst_prefix_list[0].route
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9367183Z E       IndexError: list index out of range
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9368285Z 
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9370949Z announce_default_routes = None
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9375119Z common_config = {'dut_asn': 65100, 'dut_type': 'MgmtToRRouter', 'failure_rate': 0, 'max_tor_subnet_number': 16, ...}
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9379155Z dst_prefix_list = []
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9382655Z dut_mac    = '2c:dd:e9:fc:df:08'
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9386212Z duthost    = <MultiAsicSonicHost bjw-can-720dt-1>
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9389386Z get_function_conpleteness_level = 'confident'
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9393994Z iproute_info = {'0.0.0.0/0': [{'multipath': True, 'network': '0.0.0.0/0', 'nexthops': [{'afi': 'ipv4', 'ip': '10.0.0.61', 'used': Tru...network': '100.1.0.30/32', 'nexthops': [{'afi': 'ipv4', 'ip': '10.0.0.59', 'used': True}], 'origin': 'IGP', ...}], ...}
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9398074Z nexthop    = '10.10.246.254'
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9400943Z ptf_ip     = '10.150.23.50'
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9404140Z ptfadapter = <tests.common.plugins.ptfadapter.ptfadapter.PtfTestAdapter testMethod=runTest>
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9407564Z ptfhost    = <tests.common.devices.ptf.PTFHost object at 0x7f8ea0af3710>
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9410895Z route_prefix = '192.169.140.64/26'
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9414336Z routes     = <class 'tests.route.test_route_flap.routes'>
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9419072Z tbinfo     = {'auto_recover': 'True', 'comment': 'Beijing lab', 'conf-name': 'bjw-vms6-t0-720dt-1', 'duts': ['bjw-can-720dt-1'], ...}
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9421025Z 
2022-10-18T21:10:31.9424260Z route/test_route_flap.py:156: IndexError
```
